item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Mm, I can understand that. I have gotten myself in a bit of a rut with my current way of writing (I view it pretty much as you described, for good or bad) and it can be formulaic; even the literal way of writing with short sentences rather than paragraphs is very familiar to/with me. I'm not posting lackluster Tales, but I also know they're not as strong as some of my other ones. So I understand totally where you're coming from.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
it might be just me, but this story format is getting formulaic, almost like a Power Rangers episode. A Bad Situation Introduced > Conflict Peak > Anomaly Happens > Good Side Wins(?)1. It becomes harder for me to upvote stories with premises that are simple and, dare I say, "weak" if only because it was told instead of shown to me.

Footnotes
1. The question mark is important.
